row.notes: power-unit panel view model build (0x141f50910, the garage monitor and laptop power-unit lists): slot loop rbp = slot 0..6 (0 ICE, 1 MGU-K, 2 MGU-H, 3 ES, 4 TC, 5 CE, 6 event gearbox), rax = the slot holder (*(record +0x18 + slot*0x10), record = [rsi+0x698], non-null here) just before mov rcx,[rax+0x10]; sub rcx,[rax+8]; sar rcx,4; cmp [rax+0x30],rcx; jae skip: a slot is listed only when its fitted index +0x30 is below its part count ((end - begin) >> 4). Entries keep their slot index (+0; the fit-component handler 0x141f58a20 fits the part and passes it back to the entry filler 0x141f532b0 to refill the row), so a skipped slot leaves no row. Raised by pu-1990 for the 1990 part allocation

verify.notes: V2153 Re-disassembled 0x141f50e7a..0x141f50ef8: xor ebp,ebp; loop inc rbp / cmp rbp,7; at 0x141f50eb4 rax=[rsi+0x698], rcx=movsxd(ebp)<<4, rax=[rax+rcx+0x18]; test rax,rax / je next; so at 0x141f50ecc rax = the non-null slot holder, rbp = slot 0..6, rsi = the view model. Site is mov rcx,[rax+0x10] (4 bytes), then sub rcx,[rax+8]; sar rcx,4; cmp [rax+0x30],rcx; jae 0x141f50ea7 (the row text leaves out the sar: the count is (end-begin)>>4, 0x10-byte parts). Name table lea @0x141f50eed = 0x14576e7d0 (InternalCombustionEngine, MotorGeneratorUnit_Kinetic, _Heat, EnergyStore, TurboCharger, ControlElectronics, GearBox), so the slot numbering holds. No rel32 or rel8 branch lands in 0x141f50ecc..0x141f50edb (the one rel32 scan hit on 0x141f50ed0 is mid-instruction noise in 0x1404508a0); the first 8 bytes have no RIP-relative operand. Entry +0 = slot confirmed: 0x141f58a20 calls 0x141f532b0 with r8 = [entry] @0x141f5904d. Note 0x141f58a20 is the fit-component handler (KB Car_Component_Fit, logs 'Fit component') that refits then refills the row, called 'the refresh' here. UI surfaces (garage monitor, laptop) not re-derived; the only panel string is view_model_data.power_unit_panel_ref.
